features.name: North Wing, Friend's Cottage, Kinmuck
alternativeNames: FRIEND'S MEETING HOUSE AND FRIEND'S COTTAGE KINMUCK
features.shortDescription: FRIEND'S MEETING HOUSE AND FRIEND'S COTTAGE KINMUCK
features.fullDescription: Meeting House: 17th century Rectangular building with spur stones and skews (not crowsteps). Mounting steps on boundary wall at gateway. Cottage: 1 storey. Harled. Slated roof. Wing on N side.
